name: smwgraphics-fire-emblem-heroes-d-kk-lfheimr-realm-of-nightmares
title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares
description:
This collaborative foreground + background piece is based off Dökkálfheimr, the Realm of Nightmares from Fire Emblem Heroes. It originally was a request from me to Deeke at Winter C3 2021, until I drew the background and added more decorations.

This tileset is perfect if you want to create a level that takes place in an alien environment. It also contains the HDMA gradient needed to complete the visual aesthetic, and an alternate palette if you wish to use the forest background instead.

Note: Due to Layer 3 being on Subscreen, I highly recommend you use a different status bar, such as the Minimalist Status Bar or the DKCR-styled one.

No credit is necessary, but it is appreciated!
